Row.Text: Bonjour. I am Joseph Broussard, but you may know me as Beausoleil. I don't like using the language of those who took everything from me, so make sure to be worth the bother.
Bienvenue. Our modest community welcomes you. Please tell me you speak something else than English. Mi'kmaq, perhaps ?

Why? Why am I condemned to see time and time again the destruction of what I cherish?... And you, you dare to come to see me a final time... But you'll never be worth my hate... You are just a puppet of envy and vainglory, incapable of seeing the beauty of the worlds you destroy... J'ai pitié de toi.
(look elsewhere while you talk)
You sound like my cousin Michel. Going on, and on.
Is it a test of patience?
Too many English words, and my head won't retain a single one.
Rebonjour! What brings you back so soon?
Déjà? I mean, already?
Ah, r'voilà la pie...
Qu'est-ce qu'y parle, mazette... What?
Hello! You must be wary after this voyage. Come dine with us tonight.
I negociated your safe passage. Everything's alright?
Mon ami, bon retour parmi nous. What can I do for you?
The real treasure comes to those who listen before talking. I'm listening.
Bonjour.
Bienvenue.
Be welcomed.
Hi once more.
Hello! I hope you bring good news.
Te revoilà. Everything good?
...Attention, l'ami...Our forests have become dangerous these days...
I won't waste my spit talking in English. Parle.
An actual brute has graced us with its presence.
Oui? What do you have to say... machin?
(smirking)You presence bothers us. Be worth it.
...Are you here to taunt us? We really don't need more problems.
Miséricorde! Our problems seem to be endless these days...
This war is eating at our people. Let's give them peace.
Sieur, don't you think it's time for negociations?
Too much blood has been spilled. Let's talk.
You didn't bleed enough! Dégage!
Is it me, or do you seem tired? Dommage pour toi.
Bonjour. Not too many good news, I hope.
Yes, traître?
Wealth is flowing through our lands thanks to our efforts. What a pleasure to see you again!
I'm preparing an operation for our war against {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey}.Let's make the most out of this meeting.
Our conflict against {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} has brought our people together. I hope this will cement our trust.
Envoys whispers of {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey}'s downfall. Let's prove them right!
This... enemy of yours. What's its name? Juste au cas où.
War always hurts the little folk the most. I hope this conflict of yours ends soon.
Je ne suis pas aveugle. Your men are as discreet as drunkards. Idiot.
I was wondering, are your men there to look at the landscape, or should we make them take a look at the sky?
As greedy as an Englishman, I see. Stop expending, for a minute.
Your continuous expansion is worrying. Is there not already enough land for your people?
Every land has its history. Ignoring this by forceful annexation will only lead to suffering, for everyone.
Be cautious. For the greed of one brings misfortune for all.
Impressionnante, this army of yours. Be careful to use it for good.
A strong friend makes for a good future. You have goldfingers, l'ami.
Although seeing you with so little land brings out bad memories, I won't pity you. Tu as eu ta chance.
Your barracks seem to be deserted, your walls void of defenders. Who will protect your family, when necessary?
The tyrant is showing up. You smell like blood.
As they say among the Mi'kmaq : a true friend won't ask for friendship. He will simply be. Soit patient.
Trop tôt. Trop tôt. Is it my natural charm?
{1_CivName}'s behavior has become impossible to ignore longer. Will you join me in this denunciation?
Encore un perfide! I have nothing more to say![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
Bien sûr! As one should expect, your word means nothing. Deal with the consequences![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
I have been naive, or blind. But I shall not ignore your actions any longer, perfide![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
Ta tyrannie détruit cette terre. Consider our alliance void![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
Finally, you show your true face. Do you really think I'm afraid of you, nabot?
Les masques tombent. Don't think anything good will come out of this.
Vraiment? Those were the only insults you had? You can't be serious.
Your friendship with {1_CivName} is one more proof of our strong link. I hope to make it an example for the future!
Don't think that your alliance with {1_CivName} will be ignored. This will only bring the worst out of us.
I don't care about your judgement. {1_CivName} is and will stay a friend of Louisiana, whatever you think of it.
It is indeed a waste to negociate with {1_CivName}. Let's find a way to deal with them someday.
It is a good time to mention that I, like you, have found in {1_CivName} a friend to trust. Merveilleux, n'est-ce pas?
Finally! Someone has the guts to tell {1_CivName} what we all think! Let me join you in this moment!
You try to flank us by befriending {1_CivName}, but I have many eyes ready for you all! I won't hide my disdain for you any longer!
By denouncing {1_CivName}, you just made them a more trustworthy partner. Merci pour la clarification.
I see the eyes of your men gleaming in the dark. You really think I'll just stay there and do nothing? Quel naïf!
We received news that some of your men were intruding on our lands. Is it a mistake, or should you be worried?
{@1_MinorCivName} was under our protection. Do you realize the extent of your stupidity, brute immonde?
Your aggression against {@1_MinorCivName} is known by all, and there will be consequences!
Greedy hands don't last long. Stop expending, or else.
Do you really think that these lands you just occupied are worth the attention you're getting for them?
If your goal is to starve my people by taking all good spots, know that there will be consequences!
Our allies and familied are unnerved by your continual expansion. Promise me it is the end of this!
Seeing these lands that we've explored and honored occupied by you is not something I'll accept!
Paroles en l'air! Your actions tell us enough about your lies!
This aggressive acquisition of land won't go unopposed any longer, crois moi.
Your purchase of land in my vicinity has caused some alarm. I hope this will stop.
So it seems you lied when you told us that your empire would stop purchasing land near us. Pour qui nous prends-tu?
The Englishmen too were all too keen to make hollow promises. I took up arms for less than this.
I'm happy to say that working with you has been useful. Santé!
Friendship is a house built on a foundation of trust. May this one be strong!
The land is calm, for we know that working with you was the right choice.
This world has been cruel to my people. Know that I see the value of our work together.
After talking to everyone, I realized you were so loved by my people that I had to ask : would you accept an official declaration of friendship?
Friendship shouldn't be handled lightly. Will you accept ours ?
Throughout our difficult history, we had few friends among the powerful. Would you accept to be one of them?
May your twisted mind be exposed to all![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
You cannot be trusted! May my words be heard![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
{1_PlayerName:textkey} has become a plight on the land. Will you join me in cutting down this tree?
Parbleu, we have to confront {1_PlayerName:textkey} on the battlefield! Will you add your strength to ours?
{1_PlayerName:textkey} must be dealt with! I hope you could help us in this fight.
Par tous les saints, {1_PlayerName:textkey} must be put down! Will you join us?
Your behavior's made it clear that you are an enemy of everything we stand for. Hors de ma vue!
Chacal, you are a blight among men! I'll end you, sooner or later!
Be proud of your accomplishments, l'ami, because I, for one, am proud of what you have done.
I just wanted to say that I'm really impressed by your empire.
May our future songs be about the greatness of your reign, and the fairness of your judgement.
The blood you're spilling is soaking the land. I won't stay idle much longer!
You're a tyrant, like those we left in Europe! Leave this path you've chosen, or you'll find me against you!
Our friends of the river whispers of the demon you have become. Par Saint-Michel, we'll slay this dragon, one way or another!
Your rule only brings fury and destruction. Don't think it will continue eternally, vipère!
{1_MinorCivName:textkey} is a part of our family. I won't stay idle while you try to separate it from us!
You corrupt {1_MinorCivName:textkey} with your empty promises. I warn you, don't go further.
Your sight is enough to make me sick. Ordure!
We swore to not repeat the bloody mistakes of the kings of Europe, but seeing you in your pitiful state makes me wonder...
Putride, infâme, vaurien. Those are compliments compared to what your have become.
Insulting you would be offensive to those who were once insulted. Lie de l'humanité!
So few men. Are you cowards, or just bad at making friends?
Mon dieu, qu'ai-je donc en ma possession? This... thing... this, nuclear missile, what twisted mind came up with this? Yours, perhaps?
You strike the weak, but as soon as you'll fight someone stronger, I'm sure you'll cower like the lowly bully you are!
The cries of your people echo through the forests! I didn't know you were only pretending to lead them.
Choosing a leader is a difficult task. Should I tell your people that they should find someone else to guide them? You don't seem fit for the task.
With so little land, your people is either famished, or will soon be.
We too once were too few to resist any attempt to subjugate us. We learned, but it seems you didn't.
Our songs fill our hearts with joy, and wonder, and respect. Yours sound hollow. Quelle pitié!
I come from a family of peasants, and even I know how uncultured and ignorant you are. S'en est presque triste.
{2_MajorCivName:textkey} announces to the world that it is now protecting {1_MinorCivName:textkey}. Attacking the City-State will greatly damage relations and may lead to war.
{2_MajorCivName:textkey} has taken back its guarantee of protecting {1_MinorCivName:textkey}.
Non, for this and all the next times!
...Très bien. I won't settle these lands. But don't think I'll forget this.
Parbleu, you are convincing! May these lands we talked about make your people happy!
Eh bien, for a leader, you seriously should take some lessons in argumentation. As if I'd let these lands to someone incapable of defending his claim at least a little bit.
Are you joking? We have traveled from far away to these lands, and I'm sure we will take better care of them that you.
It is with pride that I count you amongst our friends!
Very well! What a great moment! Let's drink to this!
Our great family grow stronger this day!
What? Of course not!
Is it a bad joke? Franchement...
It would be an insult to my people to accept. Rethink!
I'm never happy when going to war. But at your side, we may do things differently.
Pour être honnête, I would accept if we were ready, but we have to prepare before. 10 turns would be enough.
Peace is required right now. You'll have to pay later.
Children have to live and grow. I'll accept your demands, but new generations will make you pay one day!
Your blade is on our throat. I must accept... Quelle misère...
I don't like to boast, but you trying to threaten us is a bit funny, don't you think?
As if I'd accept the demands of a weakly fool such as you!
Your greed is misplaced. You have neither the means nor the charisma to make me comply.
Our community will never obey rabid tyrants such as you!
You should have tried to be likeable before asking anything, nabot.
Comme si! Come and try!
How many good men are you ready to lose for such demands? Just asking.
I may be a simple farmer, but I'm strong enough to crush the odd fool.
Big words from a man within tomahawk distance.
Avide! Big eyes, empty heart, empty head!
Hospitality made me accept the first time, but now, you're going too far. Dégage!
Knowing when to stop is what makes great leaders. Take a clue.
Coming back so soon, asking for more? Are you a debt collector?
Is it greed or plain stupidity that makes you think you can make new demands so quickly.
The greed of "great" men make them blind to the suffering of the small folk. Go away!
I'm listening.
What do you propose?
Both our people ask for peace. Let's give it to them.
Going any further is just pointless. Let's end this.
War is eating our children. We owe them peace.
Here are my terms. Not negotiable.
This winter has been difficult. Know that any help would be appreciated.
I don't like bothering friends for such reasons, but hard times call for hard decisions.
Your power and generosity is known throughout the land. I for once ask for your help during this difficult season.
In order to reach out our destination, we have to walk through your lands. Would you accept that we open our respective borders?
I must ask for passage for the good of my people.

I would like to lay plans for establishing a Research Agreement with your great nation. Doing so would require each of us to spend 150 [ICON_GOLD]. What do you think?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE](Agreeing will not form a Research Agreement yet)
Gaining knowledge of this world is ever important. Doing so from a trusted source even more so. Would you accept a research agreement between us?
With this deal, both our people grew stronger. Continuons donc!
Times have changed. We have to renegociate this.
Members of my community have been looking for a product of yours. Should we trade?
Hate will once again tear these lands apart. What a bloody shame!
As if I'd let my people suffer once again at the hands of the powerful. En garde!
So many lives will be lost because of your twisted mind! I hope you'll live long enough to see the effects of your stupidity!
You may outnumber us, but I'll make sure the wailing of your widows will outsound ours!
We may be few, but that's enough against the likes of you!
Are you delusional, or do you hate honest folks that much?
As a farmer, I'll dutifully weed you and your corruption out!
Do you feel so lonely, you need to make others suffer like you?
Attacking a stronger enemy isn't always a proof a courage. In your case, I would call that a proof of contempt for your own people!
Enfin! I'll end your misery!
Parfait! Maybe I'll even have the pleasure to take you out myself!
Our songs will talk about this day, and how foolish you were.
I'll listen to your cries soon enough!
You're so vile that I am still happy to battle you, despite how weakened we are right now. Viens donc, démon!
I'll cut this rotten tree that has become your empire, and your people will thank me for it.
What a saddening tale all of this will become!
Pourquoi? Why waste so much lives for something as fickle as glory?
Mon dieu... I'll fight, but my heart won't be there when you'll be put down.
Traître, vermine! I'll cut you down like the twisted snake you are!
I won't stand idle much longer. En garde!
We have eyes in the woods, ears in the towns. May those vainquised realize how mistaken they were to not join us sooner.
Time to kick the anthill! Défends-toi!
It is time to end the charade. We are at war, so time to act like it!
I'll dedicate my next song to your poor soul, l'ami. Be ready!
Langue de serpent, I'm coming to end your traitorous reign!
The tocsin is ringing, for your dominion over your lands is meant to end right now!
You're so close, I can almost feel you breathing at our neck. Prépare toi, tyran!
We need more lands for us to honor our deals. Your opinion doesn't matter here.
We have been chosen to put an end to the endless strife of this world. By poison or sword, fall in line!
Like a rolling boulder, I'll crush any who try to stop my people from claiming our rightful place! Disparait!
In a bizarre twist of fate, my hand is now on the throat of the weak. Amusant.
A true leader knows when it is time to act. Compagnons, en joug!
As if I wouldn't use this breach in your armor!
They are disorganized. Men, strike now!
A successful ambush requires an unprepared target!
Our allies are whispering about your doom. As if I wouldn't listen to them!
The balance of the world is moving quickly. I'll play my part now.
The trap is closing down on you. I'll cull you myself!
Knowing when to exploit weakness is a strength in itself!
Rust on my blade, dust in my eyes. Mais je n'abandonnerais pas!
To pierce a wolf's heart, one must know how to act in the most dangerous position.
Each fiber of my being is telling me to fight you. I'll find a way to put an end to your rampage!
Oh démon, I'm sent to make sure you leave this world!
If we win know, what incredible song that would make! Come now, démon, so that I can end you!
Your strength may be unparalleled, by a stone to the eye is enough to kill a goliath!
In this moment, I watch back at our journey. Could we have destroyed you sooner? We'll never know... But it is now or never!
I feel death approaching. Let us hope it comes for you!
I prefer betraying the world, than have the world betray me once more!
Quelle naïveté, l'ami... As if I'd stay true to my world with a good-for-nothing such as you
In a sense, I simply restore clarity in this twisted relationship. Defend yourself!
A good trap can save good lives. A good betrayal too!
Look at what I'm reduced to, trying to backstab the powerful. But my people demand it!
As if your opinion mattered here.
Oh, so that's what it feels like to not be at the receiving end!
We've had what we needed. What would you offer to end this.
Winter doesn't care for what side those displaced by war are from. I'm ready to listen to your demands.
This conflict has already taken too many lives. What do you want?
This war is far from over. Deal with the consequences of your actions!
Sérieusement? Not here, not now, and certainly not for you.
Your mistakes towards my people are yet to be repaid.
Comme si. Do you really think of me as a weak-willed fool?
Bonne nouvelle, my friend.
Excellent!
Très bien. Nicely put.
Merci. It pleases us very much.
I am grateful.
Destiny made our roads cross, and I am thankful for it.
I'll make sure our songs mention your wisdom.
Disappointing.
I hope we'll find common ground next time.
What a shame. An agreement would have helped both of us.
What follows will be your fault.
It is not over until I say so.
May you understand your foolishness soon enough.
Each life is precious. Merci, de tous coeurs.
You will be the honored guest of our next feast!
Your mercy will be known. Tu as ma parole.
Vermine! You stole our lands like an English, so you'll be dealt with like one!
Your greedy heart is never satisfied, but you'll soon reap what you sow.
My friends told me a large number of your bandits are prowling around. Be honest for once, tell me the truth.
Messengers are describing men of yours amassing on our borders. But I dismissed them, for I believe in you. Should I?
Then you're an honest but foolish tyrant!
I'll remain vigilant, just in case.
Don't think you'll stay unscathed for long, démon.
I hope so.
How unfortunate...
Truth flies through your head like wind in an empty house.
Me may love peace, but we aren't pushovers. Don't think you can insult us without consequence.
As if I could take you seriously, you poor excuse of a leader.
We may actually help your people the day we remove you.
I thought you might like to know that I've actively removing the tyrant you put at the head of {@1_MinorCivName}. The inhabitants will thank me for this.
{@1_MinorCivName}, misguided by your venomous words, was meant to be brought back to the fold by our people. What will you do, tyrant?

It's come to my attention that I may have attacked {@1_MinorCivName}, a city-state under your protection. While it was not my goal to be at odds with your empire, this was deemed a necessary course of action.
I've been informed that my empire has commenced an attack on {@1_MinorCivName}. I assure you, this was not on purpose, and hope that this does not serve to drive us apart.
We should consider exchanging embassies, which would allow for more advanced diplomacy between our peoples.
With all the lost people claiming to hail from your land, having an Embassy ito repatriate them may be a good idea, don’t you agree?
Your bullying of {@1_MinorCivName} is intolerable. I demand that you refrain from squeezing tribute out of city-states under my protection.
I heard about what you did to {@1_MinorCivName}. Did you not realize they are under my protection? Do not provoke me further.
We asked {@1_MinorCivName} for a tribute recently and they gave in. You promised to protect them from such things, but we both know you cannot back that up.
Your little friend {@1_MinorCivName} is so easy to push around. They gave in to our tribute demands, and I don't believe you are in a position to do anything about it.
It's come to my attention that I may have bullied {@1_MinorCivName}, which is under your protection. You do not put their needs above mine, I hope.

I've been informed that my armies have taken tribute from {@1_MinorCivName}, a city-state under your protection. I assure you, this was quite unintentional, and I hope that this does not serve to drive us apart.

Warm salutations to you wise leader! I'm pleased to see you also have chosen to follow the path of Freedom. The free world will be stronger with one more nation to help us all fight against oppression!
Greetings comrade! I'm pleased to see you also have chosen to follow the path of Order. Perhaps we can find some opportunities to aid each other during our empires' next 5-Year Plans!
Welcome great emperor! I'm pleased to see you have also chosen to follow the path of Autocracy. May we work together to ensure that only the very strongest nations survive to achieve true greatness!
How did one of your filthy agents somehow steal one of our basic technological secrets? These may be the last words we speak in peace.
I am willing to overlook your recent theft of one of my technological secrets with a solemn promise that it won't happen again.
I'm glad you agreed to stop this petty thieving.
Your indiscretion is not a surprise.
As you request, our agents will not conduct operations in your territory.
Our agents help keep our civilization safe from all threats, including you. They operate as we need them to, not as you ask.
Thank you for bringing this {@1_CivAdjective} plot to our attention. With this warning, we will be ready for whatever they may try. Your generous aid will be remembered.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} is plotting against you. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} is currently marching an army to sneak attack your city of {2_CityName}. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} is currently marching an army your way in a sneak attack. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} embarked an army with naval escorts to sneak attack your city of {2_CityName}. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} embarked an army with naval escorts in a sneak attack against your civilization. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
We killed your spy as it was trying to steal from us. From my experience, it is far less dangerous to read a book and try to learn something yourself.
Too many tales had come to my camp about your lands, I had no other recourse but to see for myself!
Some of the people who’ve come under my protection may not have hail from the best origins. I’ve personally have come to ask your pardon for the actions some scoundrels may have done in your lands.
One of my cities was recently burglarized and technological secrets were stolen. May I be assured that you had nothing to do with this?
I'm convinced you've been spying on my great civilization. You should stop before somebody gets hurt.
We have taken notice of the religious conversions you are undertaking inside our empire. We must ask you to cease this activity immediately!
Just be warned that this may sour our future relations.
I’m glad you can understand situations like these.
I'm glad you agreed to end this proselytizing.
Your religious fervor is unsettling.
As you wish, our missionaries will no longer share the one true faith with the people in your cities.
In spite of your protests, your citizens will continue to be enlightened by our missionaries, even though you damn your own people to live in ignorance.
We are eagerly anticipating your unconditional surrender.
Your complete capitulation sounds reasonable.
We can make a deal now to forestall your utter annihilation.
We were very pleased to hear your recent proposal to the {1_LeagueName}. It seems that our goals are aligned.
Your proposal to the {1_LeagueName} suits our interests quite nicely. You have our sincere gratitude.
Your proposal to the {1_LeagueName} is a blatant attack on our interests. I hope this does not escalate to future conflict.
I found your proposal to the {1_LeagueName} very troubling. Surely there is a better way to resolve our differences than petty politics.
Thanks to the help of your delegates, our recent proposal to the {1_LeagueName} was successful. We look forward to your continued support, and will try to return the favor.
Our proposal to the {1_LeagueName} succeeded, with the support of your delegation. Together we can accomplish many great things.
Your delegation played a part in the failure of our proposal to the {1_LeagueName}. I do not take such transgressions lightly.
Our proposal to the {1_LeagueName} was defeated at the hands of your delegates. Do not expect our delegation to support your interests in the future.
We thank you for entrusting the World Congress to our capable leadership. I expect great things to come in the {1_LeagueName}.
Sure. Bark if you want.
Anybody fool enough to be protected by you needs to be culled, as a favor to the world.
We did what was necessary, I'm sure of it.
I'll keep an eye on you.
We can't make this a fair trade, sorry.
Saying we can match your offer would be smoke in the wind.
Each trace of our ancestors is precious to us. Don't anger us any longer, or you'll find more than what you are looking for.
Why should I respect your demand when you don't even respect your lands.
I'll be reasonable and let your trinkets stay hidden, if that's what you want.
Do people really need to die for your greed?
I am grateful that we could make sure our ancestors stay undisturbed for now.
I am guided by the interest of my people, not your empty words.
Angering you was never the goal.
Individualism and greed corrupt our lands. May god help us.
The heads of my people are filled with empty promises of revolution and new order. I hope they will remember soon enough that only united we can stand.
Some believe that only brute power can guide our future. They should know that the bloody beast lives and dies alone.
For too long we have been chained by tyrants. Join us, and let us prove that Freedom is the key to a better world.
The oppressors are shaking in their sleep, for they know that the arrows of our new order will come to pierce them. Join us, or end like them.
Only through strength can we right the wrongs of this world. Join the mighty, or be weeded out.
Finally, the light of reason shines above your people. May it guide us towards peace and understanding.
The great Plan welcomes you. You will prove a worthy member of our new order, destined to finally end the wrongs of this world.
The mighty rejoice, for the deer has become a bear, and will hunt with us toward the light.
Our songs and tales, our hearts and souls, they have reached your people and found friends.
봉주르. 나는 조제프 브루사르, 혹은 보소레이라 불리는 자요. 모든 것을 앗아간 자들의 언어를 쓰는 건 내키지 않으니, 적어도 그만한 가치는 되어주시길.
환영하오. 우리 소박한 공동체에 온 것을 기쁘게 생각하오. 설마 영어밖에 못하진 않겠지? 미크맥어는 어떤가?
왜인가… 어째서 나는 소중한 것을 잃는 고통을 반복해 보아야 하는가… 그리고 자네는, 마지막이라며 내 앞에 나서? 허나 자네는 증오할 가치조차 없다네… 그저 질투와 허영의 꼭두각시, 자네가 짓밟은 세계의 아름다움조차 보지 못하는 자일 뿐… 자네가 불쌍하군. J'ai pitié de toi.
(딴 데를 보며 말함)
그 말투, 내 사촌 미셸을 떠올리게 하는군. 끝도 없지.
